name: ICCTG BCG
aliases: Interstitial Cystitis Clinical Trials Group BCG trial
registry: Interstitial Cystitis Clinical Trials Group protocol 2
question: Does intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guérin improve global symptoms more than placebo instillation in treatment-refractory interstitial cystitis?

design.population: Participants met NIDDK interstitial cystitis criteria, had at least moderate pain and urinary frequency for at least six months, and had failed at least 12 weeks of standard treatment.
design.locator: Full text, Methods, p 1187; Table 1, p 1188

verdictNote: Week-34 global response did not differ significantly from placebo.
takeaway: Six weekly intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guérin instillations yielded 21% week-34 global response versus 12% with placebo in treatment-refractory interstitial cystitis; the primary comparison did not meet statistical significance (P = 0.062).

reports.label: Randomized primary report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, 2005 Apr; exact publication day not stated
reports.citation: Mayer R, Propert KJ, Peters KM, et al. "A randomized controlled trial of intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guerin for treatment refractory interstitial cystitis." *J Urol.* 2005;173(4):1186-1191. doi:10.1097/01.ju.0000152337.82806.e8

results.measure: Patient-reported global response at week 34, with IC medication use at weeks 31–34
results.note: Intent-to-treat adjudicated response; missing week-34 outcomes and withdrawals counted as nonresponders. Prespecified two-sided alpha 0.05.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, p 1187; Table 2, p 1188

results.measure: Mean change from baseline to week 34 on 0–9 pain scale; complete-data means (up to BCG n=120, placebo n=126), longitudinal-model P value
results.note: Secondary comparisons were not adjusted for multiplicity; means excluded participants with missing data.
results.locator: Full text, Table 2 and footnote, p 1188

harms.label: Overall adverse events
harms.note: Safety set comprised participants with at least one adverse-event follow-up; between-arm P = 0.73.
harms.locator: Full text, Safety and Table 3, pp 1188–1189

harms.label: Grade 3 adverse events
harms.note: Graded with Common Toxicity Criteria, not Clavien-Dindo. One grade 4 suprapubic-pain event requiring hospitalization occurred with BCG and was judged unrelated to treatment.
harms.locator: Full text, Methods, p 1187; Table 3 and footnote, p 1189

harms.label: Serious adverse events
harms.value: 32 events among 21 participants; two judged treatment-related: BCG hypersensitivity and placebo-arm UTI/presumed prostatitis attributed to catheterization.

delivery.label: Blinded intravesical treatment
delivery.value: Up to six instillations over 6–10 weeks; TICE BCG 1 mL (5 ± 3 × 10^8 CFU per 50 mg protein) in 49 mL saline versus 50 mL saline placebo, with 2-hour target dwell; mean retention was 1.6 hours with BCG and 1.7 hours with placebo.
delivery.locator: Full text, Treatments, p 1187; Results, p 1189

delivery.label: Randomized study withdrawal
delivery.value: 17/265 randomized participants withdrew before week-34 assessment (BCG 10/131; placebo 7/134).
delivery.locator: Full text, Results, p 1187; Table 1, p 1188

delivery.label: Completed all six randomized instillations
delivery.note: 260 participants received at least one instillation; arm-specific treated denominators were not stated in the text.

reports.label: Open-label BCG after nonresponse
reports.citation: Propert KJ, Mayer R, Nickel JC, et al. "Did patients with interstitial cystitis who failed to respond to initial treatment with bacillus Calmette-Guerin or placebo in a randomized clinical trial benefit from a second course of open label bacillus Calmette-Guerin?" *J Urol.* 2007;178(3 Pt 1):886-890. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2007.05.052
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Study End Points, p 887

results.measure: Patient-reported GRA at week 68 after an open-label BCG course in prior nonresponders, unmodified by medication use
results.note: Self-selected open-label series; groups indicate original assignment, not randomized treatment in this phase. Eighteen missing GRAs counted as nonresponders; no prespecified efficacy threshold reported.
results.locator: Full text, Study End Points and Statistical Methods, p 887; Table 2 and footnote, p 888

harms.label: Open-label course adverse events
harms.note: Common Toxicity Criteria; 93% overall. No between-course difference in overall adverse-event severity (P = 0.90).
harms.locator: Full text, Results and Table 3, p 888

harms.label: Grade 3 adverse events during open-label BCG
harms.locator: Full text, Table 3, p 888; Table 4, p 889

harms.label: Hematuria during open-label BCG
harms.note: Between-course P = 0.067; no reported infection was catheter-related.
harms.locator: Full text, Results and Table 3, p 888

harms.label: Serious adverse events during open-label BCG
harms.value: 15 events; two (bladder pain and penile pain) judged possibly related to study drug. Four of 18 withdrawals were attributed to adverse events.

delivery.label: Open-label treatment
delivery.value: Of 205 eligible randomized-phase nonresponders, 156 (76%) enrolled for up to six intravesical BCG instillations over 6–10 weeks; 18/156 (12%) withdrew during the extension.
delivery.locator: Full text, Study Design and Results, p 887

delivery.label: Completed all six open-label instillations
delivery.note: Among 155 participants receiving at least one open-label treatment; between-course P = 0.0023. Arm-specific treated denominators not given in text.

reports.label: Extended responder follow-up
reports.citation: Propert KJ, Mayer R, Nickel JC, et al. "Followup of patients with interstitial cystitis responsive to treatment with intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guerin or placebo." *J Urol.* 2008;179(2):552-555. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2007.09.035
reports.followUp: 68 weeks after original randomization, among week-34 responders
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Methods and Results, Figure 1

results.measure: Moderate or marked improvement at week 68 among original week-34 responders enrolled in follow-up
results.note: Of 44 responders identified at clinical sites at week 34, 38 entered the observational follow-up; five withdrawals remain in the week-68 denominators.
results.locator: Full text, Results, paragraph following Figure 1

delivery.label: Original instillation volume and retention
delivery.locator: Full text, Discussion, paragraph beginning 'It could be argued'
